deepseek-v4.1-flash.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (also addressable as deepseek-v4-flash), tier T1. above.dev's own default: naming no model routes here ("the cheapest model in the catalog", https://above.dev/docs, retrieved 2026-09-28). GET /v1/models (unauthenticated, 2026-09-28) self-reports supports_tool_calls, supports_streaming, supports_json_mode, supports_structured_output and supports_vision all true, and supports_reasoning true, but none of this was independently probed — no key was used. Pricing uses above.dev's documented time-of-day split (peak 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays, else off-peak; weekends fully off-peak in Beijing time) so pricingPerMTok is omitted rather than collapsed to one number: input $0.165-$0.33/M, cache-hit $0.0033-$0.0066/M, output $0.66-$1.32/M (https://above.dev/docs, retrieved 2026-09-28).

errorRules.message: Invalid or missing above.dev API key (401 Unauthorised). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}
above.dev account balance is insufficient (402 payment required). Top up at https://above.dev/pricing
above.dev model '{model}' is not enabled for this key (403 model_not_allowed_for_key) — it may be plan-restricted or in private beta. Pick another model or contact above.dev.
above.dev rate limit exceeded (429 rate_limit_exceeded, 300 requests/minute per account). Retry after the documented Retry-After header.
above.dev upstream model did not respond in time (504 provider_timeout). Retry the request.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://above.dev/pricing and purchase credit — API keys are issued only after purchase, there is no free signup
2. Copy the issued key — it starts with sk-gw- (the docs give only the prefix, not a full character-set spec)
3. Manage or rotate the key from https://above.dev/dashboard if it is ever compromised — a key grants full access to your credit balance
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway at https://api.above.dev/v1, routing to a small DeepSeek/GLM/Qwen/MiMo catalog. POST /v1/chat/completions is documented as an alias that delegates to the vendor's native POST /v1/messages with "identical behaviour". No free tier for account access — a key is issued only after purchase at above.dev/pricing (the docs separately mention two lower-cap "free-tier routes", glm-5.3-flash-modal and deepseek-v4.1-flash-modal, but those ids are outside the current /v1/models roster and still require a purchased key). Account-wide rate limit is 300 requests/minute; every current model accepts up to 131,072 output tokens. The docs describe the `tools` and `response_format` request fields only as routing signals ("presence influences routing toward tool-capable models" / "scores toward structured-output models"), in explicit contrast to `tool_choice` and `temperature`, which the same table states are "passed through to the model" — so this entry does not assert tool calling or structured output as a confirmed, working capability without a live probe.
